scenes.heading: Managing multiple creator accounts without mixing them up

sents.d: Managing multiple creator accounts without mixing them up
A simple system prevents the embarrassing (and trust-damaging) mistake of the wrong voice going to the wrong account.

A clear reference document per creator (their voice, boundaries, current promotions, recent context) checked before each messaging session reduces the risk of confusing details between accounts as your roster grows.

Building in a habit of double-checking which account you're active in before sending anything, especially during high-volume messaging periods, catches most mistakes before they happen rather than after.

As the number of accounts grows, scheduling dedicated blocks of time per account (rather than constantly switching between all of them) both reduces errors and tends to produce better quality engagement per account.

take: Use per-creator notes and dedicated time blocks to avoid mix-ups.
